nodes.label: User Action

nodes.description: Handles the action and writes the notification inline.

nodes.label: Notification Row
nodes.description: Directly written as part of the request.

nodes.label: User Action
nodes.description: Publishes an event instead of writing inline.

nodes.label: Queue
nodes.description: Kafka — decouples the action from notification delivery.

nodes.description: Consumes events and creates notification records.

nodes.label: Push Channel
nodes.description: WebSocket for active users, FCM/APNs for offline ones.

nodes.label: Queue
nodes.description: Incoming events from any action-producing service.
